scope: Corollary 9.1 (Quasi-projective covers) of the manuscript “Semialgebraic universal covers of normal projective varieties” (preprints/Semialgebraic-universal-covers-of-normal-projective-varieties-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 058 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dd294523779a9237), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 61. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let X be a connected normal projective variety over C, with ordinary universal cover U. The following are equivalent: (i) U is biholomorphic to a quasi-projective variety. (ii) There are a finite étale Galois cover X′ → X, an abelian variety A, and a morphism α : X′ → A that is a locally trivial holomorphic fibre bundle with simply connected projective fibre. (iii) For some integer m ≥ 0 and some simply connected projective variety F, there is a biholo- morphism U ≃ Cm × F. A point is allowed as the abelian variety or the fibre. More generally, let V → X be a connected infinite étale Galois covering of complex spaces, with V biholomorphic to a quasi-projective variety. There are an intermediate finite étale Galois cover X′ → X, a morphism α : X′ → A to an abelian variety that is a locally trivial holomorphic fibre bundle, and an étale cover e A → A, where e A has no positive-dimensional compact analytic subvariety, such that V → X′ is biholomorphic as a covering to X′ ×A e A −→ X′ . No algebraicity of the deck transformations is assumed.
